content: Hey all. I'm building a multi-language notebook environment and I recently added Lean support. Lean itself is large but fine. But Mathlib has me in a bit of a pickle. Downloading it on the fly takes minutes so the notebook isn't interactive. And preloading it makes the Docker container really large and degrades loading time for the notebook website (now it takes ~2 minutes to set up the environment). Is there something I'm missing? The lean live playground seems to be really snappy and fast so I think I'm doing something wrong architecturally or implementation wise.
The Lean live playground is an interface to an existing installation (thin client).
